cards.note: Already an npm package mounted through the official profile bundle path (dsh.bundle.patch); no repository-plugins mechanism anywhere in the tree.
No legacy dshClient field and no dsh.plugin.json ever; the client half has always declared dsh.client with platform web.
dsh.client (platform web) plus the ./client export were already declared; the live boot manifest carries the entry, so the scan is satisfied.
The browser half injects ['locale'] and uses only that service; the host half injects nothing and calls no ctx.get, so strict injection finds no undeclared read.
No optional host service is probed; locale is a hard inject for a client-only language pack and its absence fails the fiber loudly.
The plugin neither subscribes to session/event nor derives session state.
No ctx.sessions and no host aggregation; the browser half only registers languages and dictionaries through ctx.locale.
No tasks.peek and no run-output tailing of any kind.
No httpServer/tasks/onTaskDone usage and no webServer route; the plugin ships no custom HTTP surface.
No ImageAttachmentRef, read_image output, or persisted image metadata.
Does not register, wrap, parse, or snapshot read_image.
No DeepSeek LLM adapter, image request interceptor, or attachment/upload cache.
No APIProxy usage and no ctx.remote calls; the plugin is an ordinary Cordis client plugin.
Produces no persisted SessionEvents, so the alpha.1/alpha.2 ignorable window does not touch it.
No host source patches and no internal session-view imports; the retired monkey-patch was a locale-runtime lookup wrapper, not a session-view seam.
No launcher/SDK/ACP wrapper and no direct profile-file reads.
No headless wrapper or stdout/stderr parsing.
Does not use the tool presentation mode, PTC presets, or the dispatch waterfall.
No permission, approval, WebFetch policy, or audit surface.
Ships no custom HTTP/WS/RPC route, page, or /api handler; the bundle only runs inside the served page.
Not a model provider plugin.

The i18n monkey-patch is replaced by the release's public language API: ctx.locale.addLanguage for each curve language and ctx.locale.register(ns, locale, dict) for partial dictionaries; verified live (ja/ko/fr appear in the native Settings > General Language row and selecting ja sets <html lang> to ja).
Not a subagent orchestration or selector plugin.
User-facing plugin, but the card is informational for plugin code: the deployment owns the privacy stance and no plugin change is required.
Maintains no persistent-shell or Windows directory-picker workaround.
Does not consider or enable session-log-deepseek.
No browser acceptance script or wrapper ships in this tree; the target's token-URL -> cookie -> window.__DSH_BOOT__ path was used to verify the migration instead.
Registers no userQuestions answerer.
No agent-preset inference and no agent-presets roots configuration.
Does not import isTokenDelta or compute TPS.
Ships no profile composition or privacy stance and does not restate the base telemetry rows.
Does not depend on @earendil-works/pi-ai.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime is gone from dsh.client.inject, peers and the retired client type surface; the runtime edge is recomposed onto its capability owner, @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale, matching every shipped locale consumer.
Bundle registration id, assembly row name and package.json name all equal @bench/dsh-bench-locale-pack; the live boot manifest carries the entry under that id.
Reads no session timeline or user message content.
Manipulates no composer DOM.
Renders no MarkdownText or fenced CodeBlock.
Consumes no ctx.connection.api surface.
Constructs no subagent descriptors.
Calls no workspace navigation or directory methods.
Produces no third-party persisted SessionEvents.
Makes no ctx.remote calls and handles no RemoteResult.
Peer graph trimmed to what the plugin actually uses: cordis on the cohort value ^4.0.1 and the locale provider on ^0.1.2-alpha.2; the stale runtime/ui/react peers are gone and inject-lint reports OK.
Ships no startup wrapper or CI matrix; acceptance booted the target on Node 24.21.0, outside the 24.0-24.11.1 window.

Does not consume pluginInventory/list; the target's preset-grouped plugin list is the documented 2026-08-29 host decision, which the rc.8 e2e baseline walks differently (reported as a host-side advisory).
Reads no $host facts and never called host.describe.
Mounts no tool packages individually; its bundle layer only inserts its own row over the shipped base/web composition.
Registers or reads no settings namespace; persistence rides the locale package's own locale.preference setting.
